children.subject: Clicking a storefront orders or quotes table row opens the detail in a new tab by design
children.question: Why does clicking a row on the orders list open the order in a new browser tab instead of navigating in place?
children.body: The storefront table component's row click opens the row's detail URL with window.open in a new tab rather than routing in place, BY DESIGN, so the listing tab keeps its position. It applies to /account/orders, the dashboard Latest orders widget and /account/quotes. Ctrl+click or middle-click give the same new tab, and Back does not return to the listing because navigation never happened in that tab.

children.subject: The returnable-quantity limit is enforced at submitReturn, not when a return draft is created or updated
children.question: Does createReturn refuse a return quantity above the order line's returnable quantity, or only submitReturn?
children.body: On the Return module (3.1003 pr-27 build) with theme 2.59 pr-2500, the buyer mutation createReturn with an item quantity above the line's returnable quantity (13 of 12, 261 of 260) returned 200 and created a Draft carrying the over-limit quantity. submitReturn on it is refused and the storefront shows 'Some items are no longer available to return in the quantity you asked for. Adjust the quantities and try again.'; the return stays Draft. So the limit is enforced at submit, not at draft create/update. Returnable quantity after a partial approval is ordered minus held, where a decided line holds approvedQuantity: 500 ordered, 240 requested, 200 approved gave 300 returnable.

children.subject: The storefront return wizard clamps the saved quantity but can display a quantity above the returnable maximum
children.question: Does the storefront return wizard stop a buyer from entering more than the returnable quantity?
children.body: An earlier observation reported that the storefront wizard never lets the buyer type an over-limit quantity: both the select-items step and the details step clamp the spinbutton to the returnable maximum, and a Draft already holding 13 of 12 is shown as '13 of 12 available' with Submit enabled once reason and photo are present. A later observation on theme 2.59 pr-2500 contradicts the display part: on the details step (/account/returns/:id/edit) typing past the max (5 -> End -> '0') leaves the spinbutton displaying '50 of 5 available' after blur, while the saved draft quantity stays 5 (autosave clamps) and Submit becomes enabled once reason+photo exist; a reload shows 5. The select-items step likewise shows '50' in the field while the footer counts 5 items and Continue creates the draft with 5. So the stored value is clamped but the displayed value is not.

children.subject: Saved-for-later cards omit a configured product's configuration, which returns on move to cart
children.question: Does getSavedForLater return configurationItems for a configurable product, and is the configuration lost?
children.body: A saved-for-later card shows only the product name, price and Move to cart - no configuration detail - because the saved-for-later item projection does not select configurationItems. Rendering configuration on saved cards is not implemented yet; it is a gap, not data loss. After moveFromSavedForLater the restored active-cart line carries configurationItems again (a Text section comes back as name null plus customText), and its Components list shows the chosen values. There is no selectedConfiguration field; configurationItems is the field to read.

children.subject: The list share message is capped at 250 typed characters, not link-aware, while a longer stored message shows an over-cap counter
children.question: Can a sales rep type or save a list share message longer than 250 characters?
children.body: Typing is capped at 250 characters, but a longer stored message is shown in full with a red 'N / 250' counter and no error, and saving is allowed once another change is made. A later observation on theme 2.59.0-pr-2476 disputes the over-cap wording: after filling 250 chars the counter reads 250 / 250 and a further real keystroke is not appended (value stays 250); the cap is flat, not link-aware (the appended link is 87 chars).
